notes.title: [Patchnote:Ver1.02] Overhaul for simplified Chinese translation, bug fixes and improvements.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31195508/7799b7d1d7dea1bf75c8bc1926767c7d07a17e8d.png

Improved Simplified Chinese translations.
Bullet counter gauge is max at continue in arcade mode. 
Large Dekopon pops up when Key is damaged in arcade mode and score attack mode.
Modified reduction ratio of BG gauge for Type A and Type B in shock mode.
Added hints to indicate fairy locations.
Modified amount of SP bonus after all clear.
Modified hint locations for special items.
Added equipment description in final result of shock mode.

Fixed bugs for Type-C Bullet Counter.
Fixed unintended item in stage 4.
Fixed bug that final score is not recorded after All Clear.
Fixed description errors for Final Result and HOW TO PLAY.

notes.title: [Patchnote:Ver1.01] Minor bug fixes and improvements.
notes.notes:

Fixed various problems of TYPE-C.
Fixed time recording bug of Dying Mode.
Fixed problem result screen layout of Dying Mode. 
Fixed some problems of enemy's behavior.
Fixed display problem of all clear result screen.
Fixed writing errors of ending.

Added true boss option after game clear.
Modified difficulty of stage 2.
Modified condition to obtain stars easier.
Improved visibility lasers.
Added some information for all clear result screen.
